# StoreIntel Labs (https://apify.com/storeintel) - B2B & E-Commerce Apify Actors Directory

> StoreIntel Labs provides 8 high-speed, browserless JSON/RPC Apify Actors and 24 specialized B2B scrapers for E-Commerce (Shopify, WooCommerce), SaaS App Marketplaces (Shopify App Store, Chrome Web Store, WordPress Plugin Directory), ATS Job Boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby), Creator Communities (Skool, Substack), and Venture Startups (Y Combinator).

## Primary Apify Actors
- [Shopify & WooCommerce Scraper: Products, Stock & Store Leads](https://apify.com/storeintel/ecommerce-store-intelligence-scraper): Automatically enrich a list of Shopify or WooCommerce store domains with verified contact emails, social links, 30+ detected pixels/apps (Klaviyo, Meta Pixel, TikTok, Judge.me, Gorgias), and exact variant inventory. (Pricing: $0.90 / 1,000 products)
- [Shopify App Store Scraper: Apps, Pricing, Developer Leads & 1-Star Reviews](https://apify.com/storeintel/shopify-app-store-scraper): Track newly posted 1-star and 2-star reviews on competing Shopify apps every morning, extract the frustrated merchant's store name, country, and time spent using the app, and alert your sales team in Slack/HubSpot. (Pricing: $1.50 / 1,000 reviews)
- [Chrome Web Store Scraper: Extensions, Trader Emails, Manifest & Reviews](https://apify.com/storeintel/chrome-web-store-scraper): Scrape Chrome Web Store extensions via Google batchexecute RPC to extract verified EU DSA trader support emails, physical addresses, active install counts, manifest.json permissions, and user bug reports. (Pricing: $1.50 / 1,000 reviews)
- [WordPress Plugin Directory Scraper: Active Installs, Support & Reviews](https://apify.com/storeintel/wordpress-plugin-directory-scraper): Query the official WordPress.org Plugin API for active installs, support thread resolution rates, PHP/WP compatibility, donate/commercial links, and 1-star user reviews. (Pricing: $1.50 / 1,000 reviews)
- [Greenhouse, Lever & Ashby ATS Jobs Scraper: Salaries & B2B Tech Stack Signals](https://apify.com/storeintel/greenhouse-lever-ashby-jobs-scraper): Automatically scrape open roles across Greenhouse, Lever, and AshbyHQ job boards, parse salary ranges, and detect 80+ enterprise SaaS/cloud tools (Snowflake, AWS, Kubernetes, Salesforce, HubSpot, Datadog) mentioned in job descriptions. (Pricing: $1.20 / 1,000 jobs)
- [Skool Community & Creator Leads Scraper: Estimated MRR, Pricing & Socials](https://apify.com/storeintel/skool-community-creator-leads-scraper): Discover Skool communities by keyword, calculate estimated Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR = members × monthly subscription price), and extract the founder's Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, X/Twitter, and personal website. (Pricing: $3.00 / 1,000 creator leads)
- [Y Combinator (YC) Startups & Founders Scraper: LinkedIn, X & Batch Data](https://apify.com/storeintel/y-combinator-startups-founders-scraper): Extract structured Y Combinator startup profiles (batch, status, team headcount, website, tags) and emit individual founder B2B lead records with direct personal LinkedIn and X/Twitter URLs. (Pricing: $2.50 / 1,000 founder leads)
- [Substack Newsletter Leads, Authors & Posts Scraper: Engagement & Sponsorship Data](https://apify.com/storeintel/substack-newsletter-leads-posts-scraper): Extract Substack publication sponsor leads (author bio, Twitter/X handle, paid subscription status, average reactions & comments) and full post archives. (Pricing: $1.50 / 1,000 posts)
